title: Initialize active feature planning ledger
decision: Use `pldg-20260629-001-feature-name` as the active v2 Bootstrap Planning Ledger for the exact placeholder feature token `<feature name>`. The ledger is source/planning memory only; canonical Plans and generated governance/build artifacts remain untouched until explicit compile or governance-seal permission is given.

title: Set feature name and upstream source
decision: The feature is called `Free Models` and uses `https://github.com/vava-nessa/free-coding-models` as upstream source-lineage/reference material for PM-owned integration planning.

title: Use one PM direct provider named Free Models
decision: All imported free/free-limited models for this feature should appear under one PM direct provider named `Free Models`, rather than exposing each upstream provider as a separate top-level PM provider for this feature.

title: Show upstream GitHub link in GUI comments
decision: The Free Models GUI must include a visible comments/attribution link to `https://github.com/vava-nessa/free-coding-models`.

title: Use Auto Apply for upstream updates
decision: Free Models upstream updates use `Auto Apply`: PM automatically applies validated upstream changes from `free-coding-models`, while preserving import evidence and quarantining changes that fail PM validation, security/storage boundaries, or source-mapping checks.

title: Adapt upstream runtime behavior PM-natively
decision: PM should adapt upstream runtime behavior such as schema normalizers, router scoring, fallback sets, probes, and update checks, but translate those behaviors into PM-owned contracts, storage, security, Usage pressure, and routing semantics rather than running upstream behavior unchanged.

title: List every active free/free-limited model with badges
decision: Inside the single PM direct provider `Free Models`, PM should list every upstream active free/free-limited model and use badges to expose eligibility, setup, quota, free-limited, and confidence distinctions.

title: Use native PM integration instead of Docker
decision: Free Models should be implemented as a native PM integration, not by running the upstream Docker mode or embedding the upstream local daemon unchanged.

title: Share Usage/Multi-Account pressure logic for PM-wide model failover
decision: Free Models should monitor quota/usage and participate in PM-wide top-10 provider/model auto-switching by reusing PM's Usage-owned Multi-Account pressure, cooldown, switch-reason, and resolution-outcome semantics where applicable, rather than creating a separate quota switcher.

title: Default PM-wide priority settings to global with optional per-role overrides
decision: PM should support per role/surface top-10 provider/model priority lists across all providers/models, but the default GUI mode should be a single global list to keep the settings surface cleaner. Per-role/surface lists are optional advanced overrides layered on top of the global default.

title: Use Hybrid behavior for Auto Apply invalidated priority slots
decision: When Auto Apply removes, downgrades, or marks a user-prioritized Free Models entry unavailable, PM should use Hybrid behavior: auto-promote the next eligible model for runtime continuity while preserving the invalidated slot visibly as disabled/needs-review so the user's preference is not silently erased.

title: Make top-10 priority PM-wide across all providers/models
decision: The top-10 priority list should be across all providers/models, not limited to `Free Models`. The `Free Models` provider remains the catalog grouping for imported free/free-limited upstream entries, while PM's priority/router setting ranks provider/model entries from across the whole PM provider/model universe.

title: Allow enabled costed models in PM-wide top-10 automatic failover
decision: Paid-overage, metered API, costed, non-free, and credit-consuming models should be eligible for PM-wide top-10 automatic failover when their provider/model is enabled. PM should not require a separate per-entry opt-in before automatic routing can use those entries, but must preserve cost/billing/credit visibility and Usage auditability.

title: Use both budget controls and always-on visibility for costed failover
decision: For automatic failover into paid-overage, metered API, costed, non-free, or credit-consuming top-10 entries, PM should provide optional budget ceilings/notification thresholds and also rely on always-on badges, Usage records, and normal provider/account pressure state. These surfaces must coexist rather than replace each other.

title: Default costed failover notifications to configurable presets
decision: Budget/notification controls for costed automatic failover should default to presets and allow configurable levels. The exact default preset thresholds are 50%, 80%, 90%, 95%, and 100% of the configured budget.

title: Check Auto Apply upstream on app launch and daily by default
decision: Auto Apply upstream updates from `free-coding-models` should check on app launch plus a daily background check by default, and the cadence should be configurable.

title: Use quiet Auto Apply summaries for validated imports
decision: Superseded by Jared’s q-0072 correction. Successful validated Free Models Auto Apply updates should create no notification/inbox item; only failed/quarantined/unsafe/setup-needed/cost-risk states use visible attention paths.

title: Refresh models across all providers including direct and CLI
decision: Provider/model refresh should be PM-wide across all providers/models, including direct provider integrations and CLI-backed providers, not just Free Models, free/free-limited entries, or the upstream free-coding-models source.

title: Add manual refresh button near model settings
decision: The model settings GUI should include a button near model settings that manually triggers the PM-wide provider/model refresh.

title: Default all-provider refresh to catalog/model metadata only
decision: Manual/all-provider refresh should default to catalog/model metadata only. The default refresh path must not run live probes, health checks, quota checks, model calls, or other quota-spending/rate-limit-triggering checks; any deeper probe mode is separate and must be explicit/configurable if later accepted.

title: Auto-apply runtime behavior changes only for Free Models provider
decision: Auto Apply should automatically apply validated upstream runtime behavior changes too, but only for PM's single `Free Models` provider. The exception does not extend to other direct providers, CLI-backed providers, or PM-wide provider/model refresh. Runtime behavior changes must still be adapted into PM-owned contracts, validated, source-attributed, summarized, and quarantined if unsafe or invalid.

title: Allow all automatic Free Models behavior changes if PM-adapted
decision: Free Models runtime behavior updates may be fully automatic, including declarative descriptors and synthesized/code-level adapter behavior, as long as each change is adapted into PM structure and PM-owned contracts before activation. This remains scoped to the single PM `Free Models` provider and does not permit raw upstream runtime behavior to bypass PM validation, permissions, storage, routing, Usage pressure, source lineage, or quarantine rules.

title: Automatically roll back and quarantine bad Free Models updates
decision: If an automatic Free Models catalog or behavior update passes initial validation but later causes runtime failures, degraded routing, bad scoring, or provider breakage, PM should automatically roll back to the previous known-good Free Models provider snapshot and quarantine the offending update.

title: Track upstream latest by default with pin and rollback controls
decision: Free Models Auto Apply should track the upstream default branch/latest catalog by default because the maintainer changes providers/settings continuously, while also providing pinned-version and rollback controls.

title: Reuse existing PM credentials for Free Models entries
decision: Free Models entries should reuse existing PM provider/account credentials and account state when the underlying provider is already configured, showing setup-required badges/actions when credentials are missing, rather than storing separate duplicate Free Models credentials.

title: Move downgraded Free Models entries out of active list but preserve history
decision: When upstream says a Free Models entry is no longer free/free-limited but PM still supports the model through its real provider, the entry should leave the active Free Models list, remain available through the real provider/top-10 route if enabled, and preserve a disabled/history badge in Free Models.

title: Fall back outside top 10 when prioritized entries fail
decision: If all PM-wide top-10 entries are exhausted, rate limited, unavailable, or policy-blocked, PM should fall back to the best eligible enabled provider/model outside the top 10 with a clear switch reason instead of stopping.

title: Group Free Models catalog by provider with filters and badges
decision: The Free Models provider list should default to grouping entries by underlying provider with search/filter controls and visible badges for setup, free/free-limited status, quota/pressure, source confidence, and downgrade/history state.

title: Use non-consuming structural verification by default
decision: After Free Models Auto Apply updates catalog or behavior, PM should run non-consuming structural/contract validation by default and reserve live canary probes/model calls for an explicit configurable verification mode.

title: Do not expose technical import-diff history as normal user UI
decision: PM should not expose a technical Free Models update history/import-diff view as the normal user-facing surface. The target market is users who are not developers and are just vibe coders, so normal Free Models update status must use plain language that explains whether PM handled the update, whether action is needed, and how the user can continue without requiring provider/import internals knowledge.

title: Keep technical diagnostics Advanced/Support-only
decision: Technical source refs, import diffs, behavior diffs, and validation traces should exist only behind an Advanced or Support Diagnostics area, hidden from the normal Free Models user flow.

title: Provide guided setup checklist for Free Models credentials
decision: Free Models should provide a simple guided connect/setup checklist for missing provider accounts or credentials, using plain actions rather than provider-internal terminology.

title: Use plain availability statuses
decision: Quota, pressure, and rate-limit states should be shown primarily as simple user-facing statuses such as Ready, Limited, Used up for now, Needs setup, May cost money, or Paused, with raw technical details hidden unless expanded.

title: Use plain fallback explanations
decision: When PM switches from a preferred/top-10 model to another model, the normal UI should use plain reasons like `that model is busy`, `used up for now`, or `needs setup`, with technical switch details available only if expanded.

title: Auto-suggest editable starter global top-10 list
decision: Superseded for the current Free Models scope by Jared’s no-recommended-models correction. Do not compile best-eligible starter top-10 auto-suggestions until neutral/manual starter behavior is clarified.

title: Show Free Models catalog by default but route only ready entries
decision: The Free Models provider/catalog should be visible by default, while actual routing only uses entries that are Ready, eligible, and setup-complete.

title: Keep non-critical Free Models updates quiet
decision: Successful Free Models updates and non-critical status changes should stay quiet/plain-language by default, while setup needed, cost risk, failed rollback, or quarantined unsafe updates interrupt the user.

title: Offer Use Free Models when possible preset
decision: PM should offer a simple `Use Free Models when possible` preset/toggle that configures global priority, fallback, setup guidance, and plain statuses for non-developer users, with advanced customization still available.

title: Offer Use Free Models as prominent opt-in
decision: `Use Free Models when possible` should be offered prominently during onboarding/settings but remain opt-in, rather than silently enabled by default for new or existing users.

title: Prefer paid providers by default unless top-10 order says otherwise
decision: By default, paid providers should be preferred over Free Models unless the user configures Free Models above the paid providers/models in the top-10 list.

title: Refresh eligibility after guided setup
decision: Superseded in part by Jared’s no-recommended-models correction. Guided setup should still refresh catalog/eligibility, but updating recommendation-style starter top-10 suggestions is not current-scope intent.

title: Apply preset globally by default with advanced overrides
decision: `Use Free Models when possible` should apply globally by default while still respecting per-role/surface overrides when advanced controls are enabled.

title: Sequence paid provider setup before Free Models configuration
decision: Future onboarding/doctor setup should guide users to setup paid providers first, then show Free Models and allow top-10 configuration, because paid providers will typically be preferred.

title: Auto Apply suggestions never silently reorder saved top-10
decision: Newly imported and validated Free Models entries should appear automatically in the catalog and suggestions, but must never silently reorder the user's saved top-10 list.

title: Adapt upstream runtime behavior as PM-owned adapter revisions
decision: Automatic upstream runtime-behavior changes must always become PM-owned adapter revisions that pass contract tests/quarantine, with no raw upstream project code executed inside PM at runtime.

title: Attribute Free Models usage to friendly and underlying routes
decision: When PM routes through `Free Models`, Usage records/receipts should show both the friendly `Free Models` provider and the underlying provider/model/account in plain expandable detail.

title: Show unsupported upstream additions honestly
decision: Superseded by Jared’s q-0074 correction. Unsupported upstream additions should not show up in normal Free Models catalog/detail/search/top-10/setup surfaces at all and must not route.

title: Top-10 is primary only below section-specific PM settings
decision: The user's explicit top-10 order is the primary runtime routing order only where no higher-precedence PM section/surface/role setting applies. Configurable PM section settings such as interviewer, auditor, Assistant Chat, and other scoped settings override the top-10, and the GUI must state that.

title: Keep cooldown and pressure state for temporary model failures
decision: PM should keep cooldown/pressure state for exhausted, rate-limited, busy, or setup-failed models so it automatically uses eligible alternatives now and retries the preferred model later without repeated failing calls.

title: Allow pause or exclude without destructive deletion
decision: Users should be able to pause or exclude an individual Free Models entry, underlying provider, or model from routing and suggestions without deleting history, credentials, or import lineage.

title: Store Auto Apply snapshots as hidden debug/log detail
decision: Each Free Models Auto Apply import should become a versioned PM snapshot with catalog data, adapter revision metadata, validation results, source ref, import diff, and rollback pointer, but this is a debug/log artifact hidden from normal users unless they intentionally drill into detail.

title: Fall back within section policy before global top-10
decision: When a section-specific PM model setting is unavailable, exhausted, or blocked, PM should first fall back within that section or role policy and only use global top-10 fallback if that section allows it.

title: Allow Free Models in section-specific model settings
decision: Section-specific model settings should allow users to select `Free Models` entries directly, subject to the same Ready/setup/quota/cost/underlying-provider attribution rules.

title: Use global pause/exclude by default with advanced exceptions
decision: Pause/exclude should apply globally by default, with Advanced controls for section-specific pause/exclude exceptions when needed.

title: Retain redacted Auto Apply snapshots only through Advanced/Support
decision: Auto Apply debug/log snapshots should use bounded retention, redact secrets/tokens/account identifiers by default, and be exportable only through Advanced/Support diagnostics.

title: Show actual Free Models models in section settings
decision: When a section-specific setting selects Free Models, PM must show the actual model choices rather than an opaque Free Models pool, because there is a massive difference between models.

title: Use check-based Auto Apply updates without staging
decision: Free Models Auto Apply should not use a separate staging concept; PM updates on the checks.

title: Keep paused/excluded entries visible with resume controls
decision: Paused or excluded Free Models entries should remain visible under a Paused/Excluded filter with resume/re-enable controls rather than disappearing from the catalog.

title: Use plain update summary in normal UI
decision: The normal Free Models UI should show only a plain last checked/last updated summary and action-needed statuses, with detailed import-log/snapshot history hidden in Advanced/Support diagnostics.

title: Show section-specific model badges and filters
decision: Section-specific Free Models selectors should show model-level badges and filters for underlying provider, role fit, capability, cost/free-limited state, readiness, quota/pressure, and context/strength tier.

title: Keep incompatible models visible with disabled explanations
decision: Section-specific Free Models selectors should keep incompatible or poor-fit models visible but disabled/labeled with plain reasons instead of hiding them completely.

title: Preserve known-good state after failed checks without staging
decision: When Auto Apply checks fail, PM should keep the current known-good Free Models state active, record/quarantine the failed update internally, and show only a plain action-needed status without calling it staging.

title: Highlight recommended section models while preserving manual choice
decision: Superseded by Jared’s correction: do not highlight, sort, or label recommended section models in the current Free Models version. Recommendations may be addressed in future versions of PM.

title: Do not build recommended models in current Free Models version
decision: The current Free Models version should not include recommended models, recommendation scoring, recommendation confidence/reason UI, local recommendation learning, coding-strength ranking, online review lookup, or benchmark/probe calibration. Jared will address recommended models in future versions of PM.

title: Preserve future external benchmark as out-of-scope lineage
decision: Future coding-strength/recommendation work may use an external benchmark built outside PM, run outside PM, then loaded into PM code and shipped as an update, but that is outside the current Free Models scope.

title: Use compact progressive disclosure for objective model facts
decision: Current Free Models selectors should not cram the full objective fact set into a small area; compact rows should show high-signal facts and expose fuller objective details through expansion, hover, filters, or details.

title: Use neutral starter top-10 setup without best-eligible recommendations
decision: Starter top-10 setup should avoid `best eligible` auto-suggestions for now and use neutral editable/manual setup until a future benchmark/result-update system exists.

title: Use deterministic fallback without quality ranking
decision: When all top-10 entries fail, outside-top-10 fallback should use deterministic eligibility and policy order rather than quality ranking, while still showing a plain switch reason.

title: Keep future benchmark source-lineage only for current ledger
decision: The future benchmark idea remains source-lineage only for this ledger: external benchmark outside PM, results loaded into PM code and shipped as a later update, with no online review lookup or benchmark runner in the current feature.

title: Show only essential facts in collapsed model rows
decision: Collapsed Free Models model rows should show only model name, underlying provider, readiness/status, cost/free state, and a small capability icon group, with fuller details moved to expand/hover/details.

title: Expose fuller objective fields through filters search and details
decision: Filters/search/details should expose fuller objective fields instead of rendering every field as a badge on every row.

title: Keep critical blockers visible in collapsed rows
decision: Critical blockers such as Needs setup, May cost money, Used up for now, Paused, or Not supported here should always remain visible in collapsed rows even when other details move behind expand/hover/details.

title: Use guided neutral starter template grouped by provider family/status
decision: Neutral starter top-10 setup should begin as a guided editable template grouped by provider family/status rather than a quality-ranked recommendation list.

title: Include source attribution and support facts in expanded model details
decision: Expanded model details should include upstream GitHub attribution/link, imported source/ref/version, underlying provider/account, setup steps, quota/pressure detail, cost/free caveats, and support/debug links while keeping normal rows compact.

title: Offer one primary plain action for disabled rows
decision: Disabled model rows should offer one primary plain action when possible, such as Connect provider, Resume, Change top-10, View details, or Try later, instead of only showing a passive status label.

title: Use deterministic buckets for neutral starter template
decision: The neutral starter top-10 template should be generated from deterministic buckets such as already configured paid providers, Ready Free Models, setup-needed Free Models, and enabled CLI/direct providers, without implying quality order.

title: Show deterministic fallback switch receipts without quality-score language
decision: PM should show a plain `why this switched` receipt after deterministic fallback, including selected source layer, skipped entries, user/section policy, and visible reason, while avoiding quality-score language.

title: Do not notify for successful Free Models Auto Apply updates
decision: Successful validated Free Models Auto Apply updates should create no notification and no inbox item. Routine success updates passive settings/status/detail surfaces only; action-needed, failed, quarantined, unsafe, setup-needed, and cost-risk states still surface through attention paths.

title: Show failed Free Models update attention with retry/details
decision: When a Free Models update is quarantined or fails checks, normal UI should show `Free Models update needs attention`, keep the current known-good state active, and offer Retry check plus View details.

title: Hide unsupported upstream additions from normal users
decision: Unsupported upstream additions should not show in the normal Free Models catalog, detail view, search, top-10 setup, routing, or setup tasks at all. Treat them as non-user-actionable app-support gaps, not unavailable rows for normal users.

title: Use unified all-provider manual refresh summary
decision: The manual model refresh near settings should produce one unified all-provider summary with per-provider status, while Free Models Auto Apply remains the only path that auto-applies Free Models runtime behavior changes.

title: Preserve saved unavailable model slots and skip routing
decision: When a model already saved in a user top-10 list or section-specific setting disappears upstream or becomes ineligible, PM should preserve the slot as `No longer available`, skip it automatically during routing, and ask for replacement only in settings or attention flows.

title: Keep hidden unsupported additions diagnosable in Advanced Support
decision: Unsupported upstream additions hidden from normal users should still be recorded in Advanced/Support import diagnostics and exports for source lineage and troubleshooting, with secrets/raw credentials redacted.

title: Limit successful update settings to passive timestamps by default
decision: For successful no-notification Free Models Auto Apply updates, normal settings should show only `Last checked` and `Last updated`; recent-change counts/details belong only behind details or Advanced/Support.

title: Use plain per-provider statuses for manual refresh
decision: Manual all-provider refresh should summarize each provider with plain statuses such as `Updated`, `No changes`, `Needs sign-in`, `Skipped`, or `Failed`, with deeper technical details hidden behind View details or Advanced/Support.

title: Trust only configured upstream source for Auto Apply
decision: Free Models Auto Apply should accept upstream material only from the configured `vava-nessa/free-coding-models` source/channel with content hash/source ref and PM-recognized schemas, rejecting arbitrary commands, scripts, forks, or URLs unless explicitly pinned by a future Advanced/Support path.

title: Use stable IDs and alias mappings for imported models
decision: Imported providers/models should receive stable PM internal IDs plus upstream alias/rename mappings so saved priorities, section settings, Usage history, and diagnostics survive upstream rename/move/provider-family churn.

title: Just update material upstream changes after checks
decision: Upstream changes to underlying provider, auth surface, cost/free status, quota semantics, or required setup should just update from the checked Auto Apply result. PM should not preserve the old saved choice disabled until a separate safety review solely because these material fields changed.

title: Constrain runtime adaptation to PM-owned declarative behavior
decision: Automatic runtime behavior adaptation is limited to PM-owned declarative router/probe/normalizer/fallback configuration plus tests. Upstream command execution, local proxies, telemetry hooks, credential writers, and arbitrary config writers stay rejected unless a future explicit plan reopens them.

title: Updated material state immediately controls eligibility
decision: After a checked material update, the updated state immediately controls routing eligibility. Entries that now need sign-in/setup, are no longer free/free-limited, or violate cost/usage policy are skipped by normal routing while the saved slot remains updated.

title: New Ready Free Models can enter deterministic fallback immediately
decision: Newly imported supported Ready Free Models entries become eligible for deterministic outside-top-10 fallback immediately, but are never inserted into the user’s saved top-10 list without explicit user action.

title: Run launch Auto Apply checks in background without blocking startup
decision: App-launch Free Models Auto Apply checks run after startup in the background, keep using the last known-good state until the check finishes, and never block PM startup or active work for routine checks.

title: Manual all-provider refresh also triggers Free Models Auto Apply check
decision: The manual all-provider model refresh also triggers the Free Models Auto Apply check for the Free Models provider, while all non-Free-Models providers remain catalog/model-refresh-only and never auto-apply runtime behavior.

title: Share Free Models pressure through underlying provider account model identity
decision: Free Models quota/rate-limit/exhaustion/cooldown state is keyed by underlying provider/account/model, displayed under `Free Models`, and counted in shared provider/account pressure so Multi-Account switching sees the same pressure state.

title: Use coarse pressure for unknown quota without fake reset precision
decision: When a provider gives no explicit quota or reset signal, PM infers only coarse pressure from failures/successes, uses conservative cooldowns, and never shows fabricated percentages or reset times.

title: Bound fallback attempts per request
decision: Fallback attempts for one request are bounded by a configurable global/section limit, with a plain stopped reason when no eligible model succeeds, to avoid thrashing across many providers or burning quota.

title: Show partial stream failure instead of silent cross-model retry
decision: If a model fails after partial streaming output, PM does not silently retry on a different model as if nothing happened; it shows the partial/failure state and offers a retry/switch action.

title: Default fallback limit is initial plus two automatic fallbacks
decision: The default bounded fallback limit is the initial attempt plus 2 automatic fallback attempts per request, configurable globally and overrideable by section.

title: Fallback attempt limit counts initial model plus automatic switches
decision: The fallback attempt limit counts the initial selected/requested model plus every automatic switch attempt, and resets only for an explicit user retry or a new request.

title: Cooldown entries stay skipped until expiry or explicit retry
decision: Cooldowned Free Models entries stay skipped until provider reset/cooldown expiry or explicit user Retry now. A successful manual retry clears the cooldown and a failed manual retry extends pressure conservatively.

title: Attempted-model receipts are complete and collapsed by default
decision: Usage/fallback receipts include every actually attempted model with outcome, skipped entries with reasons, and the final selected/stopped result, collapsed by default for normal users and expanded in details.

title: Automatic offline checks keep last known-good with passive status
decision: Offline/network failures during automatic background or launch Free Models checks keep last known-good active, show only passive `Could not check` or last-checked status in settings, and avoid action-needed attention unless the user manually requested refresh or repeated failures exceed a threshold.

title: Auto Apply and refresh updates affect only new routing decisions
decision: Auto Apply and model refresh changes never alter in-flight requests; they apply only to new routing decisions after the update/check completes.

title: Manual refresh failures summarize per provider without separate notifications
decision: Manual all-provider refresh failures show per-provider plain statuses such as `Failed`, `Offline`, or `Needs sign-in`, keep existing catalogs active, and offer Retry without creating separate notifications.

title: Free Models setup delegates to underlying provider setup
decision: Free Models setup actions delegate to the underlying PM provider/account setup flow, then return to Free Models with eligibility refreshed, rather than collecting credentials inside the Free Models provider itself.

title: Do not expose automatic failure threshold as user setting
decision: Repeated automatic background check failure handling has no user-facing configurable threshold setting because the user cannot fix this class of failure. PM owns any internal handling/escalation, while manual refresh failures still surface immediately in the refresh summary.

title: In-flight requests record immutable model/provider snapshot
decision: In-flight requests record the exact model/provider snapshot they started with in Usage/provenance so later Auto Apply/model refresh changes cannot rewrite attribution.

title: Provider setup return refreshes affected Free Models eligibility without top-10 mutation
decision: Returning from underlying provider setup automatically reruns eligibility/catalog refresh for affected Free Models entries and updates `Ready`/`Needs setup` states without changing saved top-10 order.

title: Setup rows disclose underlying provider and account state
decision: Free Models setup rows show the underlying provider name and account state before launching setup so users understand they are connecting the real provider behind the Free Models entry.

title: Repeated automatic failures stay passive unless routing is affected
decision: Repeated automatic Free Models check failures remain passive in normal UI and move only into Advanced/Support diagnostics unless they affect routing availability.

title: Normal Usage shows friendly names and details keep exact provenance
decision: Normal Usage receipts show friendly model/provider names while exact snapshot IDs, source hashes, and upstream refs live in expanded details or Advanced/Support logs.

title: Post-setup Ready entries can enter outside-top-10 fallback without top-10 mutation
decision: Additional Free Models entries that become Ready after provider setup become eligible for deterministic outside-top-10 fallback immediately while still never inserting into or reordering the saved top-10 list.

title: Setup rows use one plain action and preserve return context
decision: Free Models setup rows use one plain primary action such as `Set up provider` or `Sign in`, carry return context back to Free Models, and avoid import/runtime jargon in the normal setup path.

title: Routing-affecting Free Models failures use narrow affected-row state
decision: Routing-affecting Free Models check failures show a narrow normal UI state such as `Some Free Models are unavailable` on affected provider/entries while paid/direct providers continue normally, instead of a broad app-level warning.

title: Usage history preserves request-time friendly name
decision: Usage/provenance preserves the friendly name used at request time and shows later upstream rename or provider move only in expanded details, so normal receipts do not appear to change after the fact.

title: Setup action labels map to provider account state
decision: The one primary setup action chooses plain labels by state: `Sign in` when an existing provider account needs auth, `Set up provider` when no provider account exists, and `Reconnect` when an existing connection expired.

title: Advanced Support diagnostics include source, failure, impact, and redacted IDs
decision: Advanced/Support diagnostics for Free Models checks include last successful source/ref/hash, last failed check time, error class, affected provider/model IDs, and route impact, with secrets and tokens always redacted.

title: Affected provider rows show compact unavailable count and top reason
decision: Affected Free Models provider rows show a compact unavailable count and top plain reason, with per-model details only after expand/filter/search.

title: Expanded provenance shows alias rename and provider-move lineage
decision: Expanded details and Advanced/Support provenance show the alias/rename/provider-move chain from request-time snapshot to current catalog identity, while normal Usage keeps the request-time friendly name.

title: Setup launches exact provider surface and returns to originating Free Models context
decision: Setup actions launch the exact underlying provider/account setup surface, preserve a return target back to the originating Free Models row/list, and refresh eligibility on return even if the user navigates within provider settings.

title: Advanced Support diagnostics offer redacted copy/export with summary
decision: Advanced/Support diagnostics offer a redacted copy/export action for support that includes a redaction summary and never raw secret/token values.

title: Compact unavailable reason priority is fixed and plain
decision: Compact unavailable rows choose the top plain reason by priority: `Needs sign-in`, `Rate limited`, `Provider offline`, `No longer free`, `Update issue`, then `Unknown`, and use `Multiple issues` when no single reason dominates.

title: Expanded unavailable details include status context while raw payloads stay Advanced Support only
decision: Expanded per-model availability details include current skip reason, underlying provider/account, last checked time, last successful route if known, cooldown/Retry now state if known, and source/ref, while raw error payloads remain Advanced/Support-only.

title: Setup cancel or failed auth returns to origin without notification
decision: Canceling setup or returning without successful auth returns to the originating Free Models row/list, keeps saved top-10 unchanged, refreshes eligibility if possible, and shows plain status such as `Still needs sign-in` or `Could not connect` without a separate notification.

title: Stop feature-shaping questions and shift to compile-readiness scan
decision: After this row-detail/setup/export batch, the planning conversation stops generating new feature-shaping questions and shifts to a compile-readiness summary/open-gap scan before any canonical Plans compile request.

title: Close remaining source-lineage candidates as accepted compile inputs
decision: The remaining ten candidate/source-lineage atoms from upstream inspection are closed as accepted compile inputs rather than open product gaps. They preserve upstream release signals, catalog-vs-runtime risk, hidden subprovider/auth/quota metadata, free/free-limited eligibility distinctions, import auditability/risk classification, unsafe upstream runtime/storage/self-update boundaries, switch/pressure auditability, quota capability mapping, and probe/fallback adaptation constraints. Later accepted Free Models decisions remain the controlling product intent where they refine these early candidates.

title: Audit gap closure keeps implementation readiness post-compile
decision: Close the audit gap by making the readiness distinction explicit: Free Models ledger intent is source-complete enough for compile, but canonical implementation readiness exists only after explicit ledger-to-Plans compile, PlanUnits, and any later requested governance seal. Ledger-only closure does not authorize canonical Plans, PlanUnit index, governance, WorkNode, NodeSeed, executable queue, runtime/build, or implementation work.

title: Free Models wrapper preserves canonical provider and model identity
decision: The user-facing `Free Models` provider must compile as a wrapper/grouping/provider surface that preserves underlying provider_entry_id, provider_family_id, model_provider_id, auth surface, account/profile, billing/entitlement, transport, source refs, and canonical model ids. It must not rewrite stored model ids into `free_models/*`.

title: Auto Apply runtime adaptation requires PM-owned safe adapter boundary
decision: Automatic Free Models runtime behavior updates may enter PM only through PM-owned schemas and adapter boundaries with source/ref/hash, validation, tests, activation receipt, quarantine, and rollback. Code-level synthesis is allowed only through a PM-owned generated-adapter boundary; upstream executable commands, local proxies, telemetry hooks, credential writers, endpoint installers, self-update logic, and arbitrary config writers remain rejected.

title: Catalog freshness stays separate from route eligibility and probes
decision: Catalog/model metadata refresh may update rows, badges, source versions, and import disposition, but it does not prove `usable_now`, quota health, routing readiness, or capability support. Default launch/daily/manual checks stay metadata/source-resolution-only; explicit canary/probe mode must be opt-in, cancellable, bounded, and Usage-accounted.

title: Top-10 precedence compiles under Models System with explicit tests
decision: The PM-wide top-10 priority layer compiles under Models_System precedence: paid providers/models are preferred by default unless the user ranks Free Models above them, global top-10 is the default, section/surface/role settings override it and must disclose that in the GUI, and no adjacent doc may become a second provider/model precedence owner.

title: Paid and costed fallback is gated before dispatch
decision: Paid-overage, metered, credit-consuming, API-billed, entitlement-bound, org-policy-bound, and other non-free top-10 entries are eligible only after PM resolves budget ceilings/thresholds, billing entity, entitlement class, org policy, account identity, and Usage attribution before dispatch. Automatic failover must not create surprise spend or hide paid route evidence.

title: Availability labels map to canonical pressure failure and receipt records
decision: Friendly Free Models availability reasons must be derived from canonical failure_class, blocked_reason_code, account_pressure_episode, cooldown, route-impact, and resolution-outcome records rather than UI-only text. Receipts preserve attempted/skipped entries and raw provider payloads remain Advanced/Support-only.

title: Repeated automatic check failure stays PM-owned and passive unless routing is affected
decision: Repeated automatic Free Models check failures have no user-facing setting because `The user can’t fix this`; PM owns internal thresholds/escalation. Normal UI remains passive unless routing availability is affected; manual refresh failures surface immediately with per-provider status and Retry.

title: Upstream release resolver matrix is required before import trust
decision: Free Models Auto Apply must resolve upstream source state through a release-source matrix covering GitHub release, tag, commit SHA, npm version, changelog, source hashes, optional SBOM, draft/prerelease status, main-ahead-of-release, npm/GitHub mismatch, changelog missing, tag-only state, and hash mismatch quarantine. A fresh upstream check is required before compile/implementation treats catalog content as current.

title: Unsupported and removed models stay hidden from normal surfaces
decision: Unsupported upstream additions and removed/non-free models are hidden from normal catalog/detail/search/top-10/setup/routing surfaces unless they correspond to saved user selections, where they remain as `No longer available` and are skipped. Advanced/Support diagnostics may preserve source/ref/hash and redacted lineage.

title: Setup credentials route through Multi Account and cadence control gets GUI owner placement
decision: Free Models setup actions delegate to the exact underlying provider/account setup surface and Multi-Account/account-profile ownership, never collecting credentials inside Free Models. The Auto Apply app-launch plus daily configurable cadence remains backend behavior, and the configurable cadence control is an additive GUI/settings requirement that must compile to visible owner placement without exposing repeated automatic failure thresholds as a user setting.

title: Free Models compile uses explicit owner map and keeps Provider OpenCode adjacent
decision: The Free Models compile pass should use an explicit source-lineage owner map instead of deriving all routing from per-atom hints. Candidate owners are Models_System, Multi-Account, usage-feature, Contracts_V0, storage-plan, Permissions_System, FinalGUISpec, Runtime_Artifacts_Panel, Executor_Protocol, Prompt_Pipeline, FileSafe, and 00-plans-index. Provider_OpenCode is adjacent/reference-only unless a concrete OpenCode-specific Free Models hook is later accepted.

title: Free Models governance seal closed
decision: The Free Models ledger gap-closure compile is governance-sealed after refreshing migration proof, regenerating configured shards, syncing sharding evidence, refreshing Spec Lock/evidence hashes, recording the required Spec Lock auto-decision, and preserving node readiness as blocked_compiler_contract_incomplete with no node/build/runtime artifacts created.
